graph.title: Naida's Gondola & the Goblin Thief (41181)

edges.method: vine bar pushed into bar holder
basket clip on panel's central divider
telescope held in leg-skeleton hinge fork
clear gem pushed into telescope end
pin of tile in round hole of connector
connector pin in launcher pin hole
leaf plant slid on red axle end
goblin figure stands on the green curved brick behind the telescope (contact, not fastened)
bowl held by Naida near the tile (contact only; Naida's minifigure is not in the piece list)

notes: The booklet builds two separate models: the gondola with Naida (steps 1-13) and the goblin scene (steps 14-28). They are not joined in the booklet, so the two groups stay unconnected. The goblin p14 is tied to the scene and the bowl p61 to the gondola by contact joins.

Booklet steps numbered 1-13 for the gondola, 14-28 for the goblin scene (its steps 1-15). Sub-steps of goblin step 14 count as one step (27). Goblin scene is drawn at x offset 20 to keep it apart from the gondola.
p14 (goblin), p27 (card) and p61 (bowl held by Naida) are pre-assembled on page 2, before step 1; given step 0 and no grid position. Naida's own minifigure pieces are not in the piece list.

Gondola hulls p39 and p40 are modelled end to end (x 0-5 and 6-11), 3 plates tall (layers 0-2). The 1x8 plates p36/p37, brown plates p23/p24 and 1x4 plates p56/p57 sit on top at layer 3. p40 is added at step 3 after p36/p37 (step 2), but its studs clutch the plates from underneath; p36/p37 therefore list p40 in rests_on even though it is added a step later.

Wedge plates p41/p42 (layer 4) sit on the 1x8 plates p36/p37, with the 2x2 cutout facing outward around p23/p24. Their outer cells overhang the hull rim by one plate; the real hull rim shape is not clear from the drawings.
Grid positions in both models are approximate readings of the isometric drawings. The turned flag cannot show p42's 180-degree rotation.
p56/p57 stud positions are assumed; p7/p8 and p62 are placed on them.
Basket p59 is assumed to clip onto the divider of panel p60. Gems p20/p21 sit loose in it.
Catapult (p58, p28, p55) is not on the stud grid. p58 is given a position over the pin of p12. Assumed joins: p12 pin into p58 round hole, p28 axle in p58 cross hole, p58 pin in p55 pin hole.
The leaf plant p11 (with p10, p30) is assumed to attach to the red axle p28 end sticking out of p58.
Purple plates p48/p49 sit on lime flowers p31/p32; p31 on the launcher bucket p55, p32 on a stud of p44.
p52 (leg skeleton) is assumed to sit on a stud of green curved brick p51. p53 telescope is held in its fork.
